st: Galvani, Frankenstein and Poor Things: we are electric

sec.t: ff.105.1 Turning a frog into Prince Charming?
sec.p: Once upon a Volta, Galvani. In the late 1700s, Italy was at the centre of the electrical world. People wondered whether electricity was natural or belonged only to man-made materials, like metals.

sec.t: ff.105.2 Frogs, brains and ion channels
sec.p: With the discovery of neurotransmitters (molecules, so chemistry), the role of electricity in the body (and brain) seemed eclipsed for good.
Michael Levin is bypassing DNA to reprogram life through electricity.
This tangle of computers, AI and biological substrates is fascinating (we talked about it in the early days of futuro fortissimo, 🦠 ff.4.5 Computational microbes?).
